title: XcreenShot document (document.json inside a .xshot file), format 1.x
description: Positions and sizes are image pixels with the origin at the top-left corner of the canvas. Fields this schema does not list are allowed: newer minor versions add them and older apps keep them when saving (EDT-106).

gradient.description: A gradient over the whole canvas instead of the color (EDT-074): {type: linear | radial, angle, stops: [{color, pos}]}; color then holds its first stop

crop.description: Where the canvas sits over base.png (the original pixels, never cropped), in base pixels

frame.description: The crop the user chose, while the canvas is larger to fit objects that stick out of it (EDT-071); absent when the canvas is that crop. crop may then reach past base.png

outside.description: Ids of objects a crop left outside the canvas; they do not make it grow

objects.description: Annotations, bottom first. Each has an id and a type; the properties depend on the type.

flattened.description: Objects merged into the image (EDT-091), oldest first. Drawn over base.png and under the objects; they can become objects again.

objects.description: The objects as they were, in base pixels (not canvas pixels): a crop does not move them.

permanent.description: Why it cannot become objects again (blur, covered). Written files have none: such a layer is merged into base.png.

template.description: A template (EDT-095 to EDT-101, ADR 0007): its built-in id, settings and stacked sections. The objects it laid out carry `slot` (their place: title, footer, zone:<section>:<n>, caption:<section>:<n>, number:<section>:<n>…) and `section`; image zones are objects of type `zone` (see $defs/zone). Absent in an ordinary document.

settings.description: scale fit|fill, title, captions, footer, author system|custom, authorText, font, textColor, background (color, gradient or null), numbering, numberColor, numberShape, reversed, theme

kind.description: title, step, imageText, text, twoImages, gridRow, footer, timeline, milestone, compare, beforeAfter, columns3, featured

originalChanged.description: base.png is no longer the image as captured or opened: a save merged edits into it or left out cropped pixels (EDT-050, EDT-076). Absent means false.

shadow.description: Object shadow (EDT-021), in the style of arrows, lines, text, callouts, shapes, stamps, steps, pen strokes and floating images. Absent: no shadow

angle.description: Clockwise from the right: 90 is down

locked.description: Locked: the mouse cannot select or move it (EDT-085)

groups.description: Groups it belongs to, outermost first (EDT-082)

image.description: Floating image (EDT-078): a picture of the file's images/ folder drawn in rect, turned by rotation degrees around its center

locked.description: Locked: the mouse cannot select or move it (EDT-085)

groups.description: Groups it belongs to, outermost first (EDT-082)

cursor.description: This image is the pointer of a capture (EDT-093): drawn as captured or as a standard shape, with an optional highlight circle under its tip

natural.description: The captured pointer's size in pixels: its 100 %

zone.description: A template's image zone (EDT-098): a frame that crops its picture. An empty one, with its caption and number, is left out of the final image.

image.description: File name inside images/; null when empty
